en.headline: Work on Peak trail lighting project suspended amid environmental concerns
en.dek: The Tourism Board’s installations along Lugard and Harlech Roads have stopped, with the project’s future uncertain after complaints about damage to trees and the hillside.
body: Work on a lighting project along walking trails on The Peak has been suspended, the South China Morning Post reported on Wednesday, after mounting complaints that the installations were damaging the environment.

The Hong Kong Tourism Board had planned small lighting installations at selected points on Lugard Road and Harlech Road, intended to run with a new light show for Hong Kong WinterFest. Residents and hikers raised concerns about trees and flowers being affected, and about the fixtures being an eyesore on the hillside paths.

Earlier this week the Board said it valued residents’ views and would conduct broader consultation to review the overall arrangements and refine details, aiming to balance tourism development, environmental protection and residents’ needs. No workers were seen on the trails on Tuesday, with installations remaining behind barriers. The project’s future remains uncertain pending the review.

zh.headline: 山頂步行徑燈影項目工程暫停 環境關注升溫
zh.dek: 旅發局在盧吉道及夏力道的燈光裝置工程已停止，項目未來未明，市民憂慮損樹及破壞山徑環境。
body: 《南華早報》周三報道，山頂步行徑的燈光裝置工程已暫停，因市民對項目損害環境的關注日益增加。
香港旅遊發展局原計劃在盧吉道及夏力道部分位置設置小型燈光裝置，配合「香港繕紛冬日巡禮」的新光影匯演推出。居民及行山人士投訴樹木及花卉受影響，亦指裝置礙眼，破壞山徑寧靜氛圍。
旅發局較早前表示重視居民意見，會進行更廣泛諮詢，檢視項目整體安排及優化細節，務求在旅遊發展、保護自然環境及居民需要之間取得平衡。周二現場未見工人，裝置仍被圍欄擋住。項目未來仍待檢討後決定。
